values.eip_label: EIP-4788 · Beacon block root in the EVM
values.event_label: Major redesign and revival ("Move to Draft"): retitles the EIP to "Beacon block root in the EVM"; switches from exposing the beacon state root via the ommers field to appending the parent beacon block's hash tree root as a new header field; renames the opcode to BEACON_ROOT keyed by slot with a SLOTS_PER_HISTORICAL_ROOT (8192) ring buffer; adds author Ansgar Dietrichs; updates discussions-to; status Stagnant -> Draft; removes the EIP-4399/EIP-3675 background references while keeping EIP-2935.
values.rationale: Complete replacement of the exposed value (state root -> block root), commitment location (ommers -> header field), keying (block number -> slot), and storage bounding (unbounded -> ring buffer); all core normative behavior changed.
values.source_title: Update EIP-4788: Move to Draft

values.eip_label: EIP-4788 · Beacon block root in the EVM
values.event_label: "Minor nits": strengthens "should be converted to 32 bytes with big-endian encoding" to "must be converted"; corrects "requested block number" to "requested slot number"; adds "avoid breaking changes to smart contracts" to the BLOCKHASH rationale; removes stray whitespace.
values.rationale: Mostly wording, but the should->must change materially strengthens a normative encoding requirement for storage keys, which affects implementations; classified substantive on that basis.
values.source_title: Update EIP-4788: minor nits for 4788

values.event_label: "Send current slot from CL to avoid timestamp conversions": adds a second header extension (8-byte big-endian slot number) and rewrites block processing to read the last written slot from storage and iterate from start slot to end slot, writing the parent beacon block root into each ring-buffer slot.
values.rationale: Changes the header schema and the storage-update algorithm; normative behavior.
values.source_title: Update EIP-4788: send current slot from CL to avoid timestamp conversions

values.eip_label: EIP-4788 · Beacon block root in the EVM
values.event_label: "Favor stateful precompile over opcode": removes the BEACON_ROOT opcode (OPCODE_VALUE deleted) in favor of a stateful precompile at HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS read via calldata; raises G_beacon_root from 20 to 2100; removes the EIP-2935 inspiration reference.
values.rationale: Replaces the read interface mechanism (opcode -> precompile) and its gas cost.
values.source_title: Update EIP-4788: favor stateful precompile over opcode

values.eip_label: EIP-4788 · Beacon block root in the EVM
values.event_label: "Key beacon roots by root": drops the slot keying and SLOTS_PER_HISTORICAL_ROOT constant; storage is now keyed by the root itself with the header timestamp as value; removes the extra 8-byte slot header field (header extension reverts to the 32-byte root only); precompile queries by root and returns the timestamp.
values.rationale: Changes storage layout, header schema, and precompile query semantics.
values.source_title: Update EIP-4788: key beacon roots by root

values.source_title: Update EIP-4788: clarify header and validity sections

values.eip_label: EIP-4788 · Beacon block root in the EVM

values.rationale: Changes storage bounding, gas, validation requirements, and read semantics.

values.rationale: Wholesale redesign of the mechanism from precompile to system contract with new addresses, bytecode, deployment, and block-processing semantics.
values.source_title: Update EIP-4788: initial stab at v2

values.eip_label: EIP-7514 · Add Max Epoch Churn Limit
values.event_label: Renames the constant MAX_PER_EPOCH_CHURN_LIMIT to MAX_PER_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_CHURN_LIMIT (value 8 unchanged) and replaces the single consensus-layer bullet 'Modify get_validator_churn_limit function adding an upper bound' with two bullets - 'Add get_validator_activation_churn_limit with upper bound MAX_PER_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_CHURN_LIMIT' and 'Modify process_registry_updates to use bounded activation churn limit'.
values.rationale: More than a rename - it narrows the specified change from bounding the shared churn-limit helper to adding a separate activation-only helper consumed by process_registry_updates, so the bound applies to the entry queue and not to exits. Changes both the identifier implementers must use and the function-level shape of the state-transition change. PR #7717 records the intent as 'Align EIP variable names to https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3499'. Left ungrouped from eip7514-e01 despite landing two hours later on the same day - the parameter value change and the helper-scope change are distinct decisions with distinct upstream references.
